payload.summary: Teaching: no in-app QR scanner; check-in relies on the phone's own camera app
payload.detail: Owner product decision needed (raised in the Teaching Mode polish, PR #3200). Today attendees scan the projector QR with the phone camera or type the 6-digit code; the Today button was renamed 'Check in with code' so it does not promise a scanner. Next action: owner decides whether an in-app scanner (camera permission, BarcodeDetector or a library, fallback to typed code) is worth building; if yes, design it inside the Today hero action, keep typed-code fallback, add no new route without wiring.
